Game Overview

Spooky Saw Sprint is a halloween game built around race against time as the Pumpkin-Headed Man in Spooky Saw Sprint. Navigate through haunted terrains, dodging deadly rotating hex saws. Test your reflexes with every jump and dodge in this adrenaline-fueled experience, and strive to survive as long as possible for a high-octane, thrilling challenge.

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Spooky Saw Sprint is easy to pick up. Race against time as the Pumpkin-Headed Man in Spooky Saw Sprint.
